description_expanded: ABOUT ENDLESS WAVES 208: Welcome to Endless Waves 208, a newly updated 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom beach retreat located in the private residence of Eastern Shores in the heart of Seagrove Beach. This charming oasis accommodates up to 6 guests and offers an unparalleled view of the breathtaking Emerald Coast waters upon entry. Adorned in modern beach decor, the open living and dining area provides a relaxing space for both leisure and entertainment post-beach activities. The fully renovated kitchen, boasting ample counter space, stocked utensils, and state-of-the-art appliances, is a culinary enthusiast's delight. Step out onto the spacious private balcony, a sought-after spot to unwind and absorb the soothing sounds of the rolling waves. The master bedroom features a luxurious King-size bed, a flat-screen TV, and access to the recently updated Jack & Jill bathroom with a tiled shower. Further down the hallway cubby, you'll find the charming bunk beds suitable for children, while the queen sleeper sofa in the living room offers additional sleeping space. Endless Waves 208 is perfectly situated in an exclusive area with easy beach access on a tranquil dead-end street, providing a peaceful retreat away from the crowds. Should you wish to venture out, a short bike ride or drive to the neighboring town of Seaside offers a plethora of dining and shopping options. Whether seeking relaxation or adventure, Endless Waves 208 on the majestic Emerald Coast promises a memorable getaway that you won't soon forget. ABOUT THE AREA: Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community located along Scenic Highway 30A in the Florida Panhandle. Situated between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, Seagrove Beach epitomizes the laid-back and picturesque beach lifestyle that the area is known for. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, emerald green waters, and towering sand dunes, Seagrove Beach offers a serene and relaxed ambiance that attracts visitors looking for a peaceful getaway. The beach in Seagrove is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and simply enjoying the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. In addition to its beautiful beach, Seagrove Beach is surrounded by natural beauty, including rare coastal dune lakes, pine forests, and state parks. Visitors can explore hiking and biking trails, go birdwatching, or take a leisurely walk along the scenic coastline to appreciate the area's unique ecosystem. Seagrove Beach is also home to a variety of charming beach cottages, luxury vacation rentals, boutique shops, and delicious restaurants serving fresh seafood and local cuisine. The community has a laid-back and friendly vibe, making it a favorite destination for families, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts looking to unwind and reconnect with nature. Along Scenic Highway 30A, visitors can explore neighboring beach communities, each with its own distinct character and amenities. From art galleries and coastal dune lakes to live music events and farmers markets, there is always something to see and do along this scenic stretch of coastline. Overall, Seagrove Beach is a hidden gem along Scenic Highway 30A, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, relaxation, and Southern hospitality that captures the essence of the Florida Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Eastern Shores Private Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 5 minute bike ride from downtown Seagrove. * Directly on the beach. * Incredible gulf views. PARKING: * Free Parking for 1 Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
